{{Quote|He cut a deal with another Hutt, Gardulla. Gardulla got all slave trading, Jabba got all other illegal activities.|[[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]], about [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]|<ref name="SWG:JPEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Ephant Mon|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
A '''criminal empire''' [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|affiliated]] with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] was led by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and was based on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He began his illicit operation out of his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on Tatooine [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|onset]] on the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], from where he spread his operations and influence across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] by employing a network of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who moved his goods across the galaxy, forming a powerful criminal empire.

==History==
===Creation===
At the incredibly young age of 80, Jabba established his criminal empire on the remote desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and moved his criminal operations into an old [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|B'omarr Monastery]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of the Star Wars Trilogy">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

===Height of power===
{{Quote|I have no wish to offend the Jedi. This would benefit no one.|Jabba, deceiving Ki-Adi-Mundi|<ref name="Star Wars Republic: Outlander">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Jabba_Boonta_Eve.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jabba became a notorious crime lord.]]
On a mission, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] found evidence that linked Jabba with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and it preparation for its [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], but Jabba escaped any serious retribution<ref name="Star Wars Republic: Prelude to Rebellion">''[[Star Wars: Prelude to Rebellion]]''</ref> and continued to rule over Tatooine.<ref name="Star Wars Republic: Outlander" />

Jabba had a fierce rivalry with [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] that lasted for decades, with the two were vying for control of the planet for nearly three decades.<ref name="SWDPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who was betided with his [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi apprentice]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was reluctant to [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|return]] to Tatooine, via the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] to discuss allowing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] access over the secret Hutt [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in excharge for [[Battle of Teth/Legends|rescuing]] his son [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] on the [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] emerged victorious at delivering Rotta to Jabba's Palace, despite sabotage from [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Thus subsequently the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], became an ally of the Republic, as well as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] been allowed safe passage through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the Arkanis sector.<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

===Imperial Period===
{{Quote|What are you, some kind of Imperial spy? Everything we do around here is illegal. Unless you really are an Imperial spy, in which case I was kidding. No, wait, Jabba's paid off the Imperials, so it doesn't matter.|[[Barada/Legends|Barada]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Barada|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] enjoyed an uneasy alliance with the regime, which cautiously refused to interfere much in halting his nefarious operations so as to prevent the crashing down of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] economy. Nonetheless, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Jabba's best [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] on his payroll, was forced to jettison a shipment of [[Glitterstim/Legends|Kessel spice]] when the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' was boarded by an Imperial patrol. Wanting to gain some compensation for his lost cargo of spice, the Hutt sent [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after the runaway smuggler. After the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] was killed by Solo, the latter spoke with Jabba at [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] relented, giving him more time although not before reminding him what failure to deliver on his promise meant.<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

[[File:JabbaAmbush-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Jabba in his palace with several of his followers and enemies]]
The crime family also became locked in a gang war with the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], that started on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] where the Hutt intended to sell an [[Carbonite Sith Army holocron|ancient Sith artifact]] to the Empire. [[Tyber Zann]] sent a taskforce and wiped out Jabba mercenaries but was took into custody by the totalitarian government and sentenced to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where he escaped and narrowly avoided execution by a [[Unidentified Mustafarian bounty hunter|bounty hunter]] hired by his rival. Zann would eventally make an agreement with Jabba stating that he would not make any overtures to any Hutt world but for [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] which would hence be his.<ref name="FOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

Before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Jabba was [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|killed]] by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] on [[Khetanna/Legends|his]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|barge]] during [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Return">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

===Death of Jabba===
{{Quote|Jabba, this is your last chance. Free us, or die.|Luke Skywalker at the Great Pit of Carkoon|<ref name="Return" />}}
[[File:Jabbabody.png|thumb|left|250px|Jabba's corpse, after his strangulation.]]
Following Jabba's demise, his own base of operations was reclaimed by the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] and his empire began to collapse as its remnants were taken over by his greedy lieutenants. The [[Kian'thar]] [[Llleag'Mak]] would use intimidation and bribery to take control over pieces of Jabba's empire. The Rodian [[Revidjasa]] made key alliances with [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] and [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] cartels, taking over Jabba's slaving operations in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Revidjasa was on his way to becoming a permanent fixture in that region during the struggle between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="gg11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>

[[Kumac]] was the quickest to act of all the Hutts, allying herself with [[Brasck]], a [[Brubb]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] formerly under the employ of Jabba, who had seized some of Jabba's [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] operations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. With Brasck's aid, she had gained control of Jabba's leading syndicate operations in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] within weeks of Jabba's death, with her peers still reeling from it. Kumac also called in favors from her Imperial contacts to set her up with sufficient power to fend off any major attack upon her, while Brasck set off his own smuggling operation.<ref name="gg11" />

Kumac's old rival, [[Jelasi]], had also performed well in the aftermath of Jabba's demise, claiming for himself the [[Ig'zxyck Flare]] syndicate and attempting to "legitimize" much of Jabba's old operations, assassinating those who opposed the new direction he was taking. Kumac and her clan were enraged by this, as they wished to carry on in the same vein as Jabba, using crime and intimidation to gain more power.<ref name="gg11" />

As it happened, though, the two emerged as the new joint leaders of the Desilijic kajidic&mdash;and, by extension, the leaders of Hutt Space, because of Desilijics' dominance&mdash;after a brutal round of infighting,<ref name="negtc">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> because they had both claimed more of Jabba's holdings than anyone else.<ref name="egtc">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

===Reclaimed by the Desilijics===
{{Dialogue|Zorba|I am Zorba the Hutt, the father of Jabba! I want someone to tell me where I can find my son! I was told that Hutts are no longer permitted in Jabba's palace! Who owns the palace, if not Jabba?|Tibor|If I were you, Zorba, I'd calm down. Have yourself a zoochberry juice.|Zorba|I will ''not'' calm down! I want information about Jabba! And I'll pay five gemstones to anyone who talks!|Hissa|You seem to be about the only creature this side of the Dune Sea who doesn't know that Jabba the Hutt is dead.|attr=Zorba, Tibor, and Bertroff Hissa|src=<ref name="Zorba">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>}}
A [[5 ABY/Legends|year later]], Jabba's [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|father]] came and resurrected his empire, this was due to Zorba discovering Jabba's [[Jabba the Hutt's Will|"true will and testament"]], which entitled the elder Hutt to all of Jabba's holdings. Through the courts, Zorba was able to take control of the clan and wrest Kumac and Jelasi's control from their helpless hands. However, his reign was only brief and ended after a series of events included his attempted revenge against his son's killer and the will declared a forgery by the Hutt courts. Zorba was disgraced and went into hiding, thought to have died. Soon after that, Jabba's [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|nephew]] began to slither in his uncle's footsteps and grow Jabba's empire farther than the Hutt himself. The [[palace of Gorga the Hutt]] became the new headquarters of the criminal empire.<ref name="HHH">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030911hutt|text=Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!}}</ref>

===Yuuzhan Yong War===
During the [[New Republic era]], it was supported by [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] most of Hutt Space was devastated by the invaders, Gorga's Palace was the base of operations for the [[Hutt underground|Hutt Underground]] for one year. When the war had ended the Hutt rebellion against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] returned to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. A year later, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] had claimed authority on Tatooine, leaving a question if the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Empire (disambiguation)|Empire]] would meet a second demise.
